name: whisper-medium-finetuned
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-medium (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-02. A finetune of openai/whisper-medium, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.764 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence mit, repo created 2026-09-21. CAVEAT: the card contradicts itself - one table prints 'Global' baseline WER 0.322 -> 0.095 (-70%), another prints 0.114 -> 0.095. Only the 0.114/0.095 pair is a same-table comparison and only that row is recorded; the -70% headline should not be read as a 70% relative gain. Train data is 1,800 FLEURS samples with reverb/white-noise augmentation, 100 samples/language.

benchmarks.name: FLEURS WER
benchmarks.config: Card table comparing against whisper-large-v3, row '| whisper-medium (original) | 0.114 | 5 |' vs '| whisper-medium (fine-tuné) | 0.095 | 3 |': base 11.4 vs this model 9.5 (also 5 vs 3 hallucinated 'Merci.' segments). Full fine-tune on 1,800 FLEURS samples augmented with reverb (0.3/0.5) and white noise (SNR 5 dB), 2 epochs, lr 1e-5. CAVEAT: the card's other table reports a 'Global' baseline of 0.322 -> 0.095 (-70%), which contradicts the 0.114 in this table; only the 0.114/0.095 pair is a same-table comparison and is the one recorded.
